title: Flow Note Simple Rectangle
description: Refactor flow Note input widget from legacy IO-widget chrome to a simple content-sized resizable rectangle displaying its text string, matching the preview scalar pattern.
summary: Replaced legacy IO-widget Note chrome with a content-sized rectangle: note_widget_size/fit_note_sizes in DAG, scalar-style centered text painting, no title/port JS overlays, and set_note_text now syncs DAG + resizes the node when text changes.
